zoe (CS): Vela weekly tail check — customer sees higher p99 on /summarize (streaming) this week. Posting quick snapshot and proposed mitigations.

telemetry-bot: Period 2024-07-05 -> 2024-07-11 for account=vela:
- spend: $2.9k (+9% WoW)
- streaming share: 64% tokens
- /summarize (model=rwd-14b-lite-q4): streaming p95=480ms, p99=1.15s, err=0.48% ; non-streaming p95=350ms, p99=620ms, err=0.10%
- /chat (rwd-7b-v2): streaming p95=140ms, p99=300ms

zoe (CS): p99 gap ~+530ms on summarize streaming. Customer mentions many long sessions from their mobile app.

ethan (Eng): initial read: high concurrency + long prefixes -> KV churn on 14b-lite. We can try: 1) enable prefix cache for top-100 prefixes, 2) adaptive batching (raise batch_target for streaming pool), 3) soft-shed policy for >3k tokens to fallback to 7b.

priya (SE): For client workaround, suggest max_tokens_hint=2500 and a sample-based fallback to smaller model for heavy sessions. Provide snippet for clients.

telemetry-bot: p99 by length (streaming /summarize): <=512=420ms; 513-2048=830ms; >2048=1.8s (2% requests). Queue backlog observed on pool vela-14b-stream 18:40-19:10 UTC avg_queue=11.

ethan (Eng): Plan: canary config tomorrow 08:00 UTC with prefix_cache on + batch_target=14 + KV_soft_evict=0.78, steer 8% traffic. Monitor p99 by bucket and GPU mem.

zoe (CS): Action items: Ethan deploys canary; Priya prepares client snippet & CS note; Zoe will inform Vela PM and ask to enable hint for 48h. Any objections? :thumbsup:

priya (SE): no objections, will push snippet to customer docs.

ethan (Eng): will schedule canary and post results here after run.

telemetry-bot: Will post canary diff and queue metrics when available.
